title: Growing an Agent/Prover Interface: Evolutionary Tool Design for Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving in Rocq and Lean
abstract: arXiv:2609.39544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent achievements in AI-assisted mathematics require intensive interaction of agents with proof assistants to generate machine-checked proof certificates. Agents interact with proof assistants such as Rocq or Lean through an interface that controls what the agent receives from the prover and the cost of these interactions. Today, these interfaces are adapted from tools designed for humans and not optimized for agents. We propose an evolutionary method where a frontier model incrementally proposes new features and only keeps the ones that improve the overall performance of smaller models. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by growing, on a curated set of mathematical problems, \rme, a new MCP server for the Rocq prover. translated_title: 培育智能体/证明器接口：面向Rocq和Lean中低成本高效定理证明的演化式工具设计
translated_abstract: AI辅助数学领域的最新成果需要智能体与证明助手进行密集交互，以生成经过机器验证的证明证书。智能体通过一个接口与Rocq或Lean等证明助手交互，该接口决定了智能体能从证明器接收的内容以及这些交互的成本。目前，这些接口都是从为人类设计的工具改编而来，并未针对智能体进行优化。我们提出了一种演化式方法：由前沿模型逐步提出新的接口特性，并且只保留那些能够提升较小模型整体性能的特性。我们通过在一组精心筛选的数学问题上培育出 εme——一个面向Rocq证明器的新型MCP服务器——来验证该方法的有效性。在miniF2F-Rocq的留出测试集上，配备 εme 的智能体在来自两大家族的四个模型上，均优于仅暴露Rocq编译器的基线方案和一个成熟的MCP服务器。
tldr: 提出一种演化式工具设计方法，由前沿模型逐步提出并筛选接口特性，培育出面向Rocq证明器的新型MCP服务器 εme，使智能体能够以更低的交互成本在定理证明任务上超越现有基线。
en_tdlr: An evolutionary tool-design method where a frontier model incrementally proposes and filters interface features yields εme, a new MCP server for the Rocq prover that enables agents to outperform existing baselines with cost-efficient theorem proving.
